# netbox_service_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a single service template from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_service_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the service template. At least one of `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the service template.
- `description` (String) A description of the service template.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the service template.
- `port_mappings` (Set of String) The port mappings of the service template.
- `ports` (Set of Number) The ports of the service template.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of the service template.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
